```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)

required_packages <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "readr", "scales", "knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing R package(s): ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall with: install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('\"%s\"', missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
    "))"
  )
}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

base_dir <- dirname('/Users/leili/Documents/GitHub/PROS/test_para/results/gonzalez_init_runs.csv')
if (is.na(base_dir) || base_dir == "") {
  base_dir <- getwd()
}

runs_path <- file.path(base_dir, "gonzalez_init_runs.csv")
runs <- read_csv(runs_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(
      dataset,
      levels = c("balanced_clusters", "imbalanced_clusters"),
      labels = c("Balanced clusters", "Imbalanced clusters")
    )
  )

summary_tbl <- runs |>
  group_by(dataset, n) |>
  summarise(
    num_seeds = n(),
    delta_mean = mean(delta),
    delta_sd = sd(delta),
    delta_cv = delta_sd / delta_mean,
    delta_min = min(delta),
    delta_max = max(delta),
    delta_range = delta_max - delta_min,
    delta_range_ratio = delta_max / delta_min,
    opt_lower_mean = mean(opt_lower),
    opt_lower_sd = sd(opt_lower),
    opt_lower_cv = opt_lower_sd / opt_lower_mean,
    opt_lower_min = min(opt_lower),
    opt_lower_max = max(opt_lower),
    opt_lower_range = opt_lower_max - opt_lower_min,
    opt_lower_range_ratio = opt_lower_max / opt_lower_min,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

theme_paper <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 7, height = 4.5) {
  ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height)
  ggsave(
    file.path(base_dir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 600
  )
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_tbl |>
  mutate(
    delta_mean = round(delta_mean, 4),
    delta_sd = round(delta_sd, 4),
    delta_cv = percent(delta_cv, accuracy = 0.01),
    delta_min = round(delta_min, 4),
    delta_max = round(delta_max, 4),
    delta_range = round(delta_range, 4),
    delta_range_ratio = round(delta_range_ratio, 4),
    opt_lower_mean = round(opt_lower_mean, 4),
    opt_lower_sd = round(opt_lower_sd, 4),
    opt_lower_cv = percent(opt_lower_cv, accuracy = 0.01)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Gonzalez initialization sensitivity across 20 random seeds.")
```

## Figure 1: Distribution of Gonzalez Hop Distance

This figure shows the seed-to-seed variation in `delta`, the final hop
distance from a Gonzalez traversal to `n + 1` points. Since
`opt_lower = delta / 2`, relative variation in `delta` is identical to
relative variation in the certified lower bound.

```{r delta-distribution}
p_delta <- ggplot(runs, aes(x = dataset, y = delta, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.42, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 2.1,
    alpha = 0.82
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gonzalez initialization sensitivity",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(delta)
  ) +
  theme_paper

p_delta
save_plot(p_delta, "fig_gonzalez_delta_distribution")
```

## Figure 2: Seed-Level Values

```{r delta-by-seed}
p_seed <- ggplot(runs, aes(x = seed, y = delta, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 19, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Seed-level Gonzalez hop distance",
    x = "Initialization seed",
    y = expression(delta)
  ) +
  theme_paper

p_seed
save_plot(p_seed, "fig_gonzalez_delta_by_seed")
```

## Figure 3: Certified Lower Bound

```{r opt-lower-distribution}
p_opt <- ggplot(runs, aes(x = dataset, y = opt_lower, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.42, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 2),
    size = 2.1,
    alpha = 0.82
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Certified lower bound across Gonzalez initializations",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(OPT[n] >= delta / 2)
  ) +
  theme_paper

p_opt
save_plot(p_opt, "fig_gonzalez_opt_lower_distribution")
```

## Text for Manuscript

```{r manuscript-text, results='asis'}
balanced <- summary_tbl |> filter(dataset == "Balanced clusters")
imbalanced <- summary_tbl |> filter(dataset == "Imbalanced clusters")

cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "For the balanced synthetic dataset, the Gonzalez-derived packing distance ",
    "was highly stable across 20 random initializations at n = %d ",
    "(mean delta = %.4f, SD = %.4f, CV = %.2f%%; range %.4f-%.4f).\\n\\n"
  ),
  balanced$n,
  balanced$delta_mean,
  balanced$delta_sd,
  100 * balanced$delta_cv,
  balanced$delta_min,
  balanced$delta_max
))

cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "For the imbalanced synthetic dataset, initialization sensitivity remained ",
    "small despite stronger heterogeneity ",
    "(mean delta = %.4f, SD = %.4f, CV = %.2f%%; range %.4f-%.4f).\\n\\n"
  ),
  imbalanced$delta_mean,
  imbalanced$delta_sd,
  100 * imbalanced$delta_cv,
  imbalanced$delta_min,
  imbalanced$delta_max
))

cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Because opt_lower is defined as delta / 2, the same relative stability ",
    "holds for the certified lower bound: CV = %.2f%% for the balanced dataset ",
    "and %.2f%% for the imbalanced dataset. These results indicate that the ",
    "reported lower-bound certificate is not materially driven by the arbitrary ",
    "initial Gonzalez seed in these representative settings.\\n"
  ),
  100 * balanced$opt_lower_cv,
  100 * imbalanced$opt_lower_cv
))
```
